title: Military OneSource Program - Request for Proposal (RFP) 47QFCA23R0053
agency_path: GENERAL SERVICES ADMINISTRATION.FEDERAL ACQUISITION SERVICE.GSA FAS AAS FEDSIM
detail_text: This is a special notice regarding Contract 47QFCA25C0002, which was awarded to Cognosante, LLC on May 28, 2025. This contract was issued by the General Services Administration (GSA) Assisted Acquisition Services (AAS) under Request for Proposal (RFP) 47QFCA23R0053 in support of the Office of the Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Military Community and Family Policy (MC&FP). This Contract 47QFCA25C0002 has been terminated for cause pursuant to FAR 52.212-4(m), Termination for Cause effective April 17, 2026.
